# Needle 3 attribution

HyperHub embeds the Needle 3 model weights and the matching platform runner from
Cactus Compute's `Cactus-Compute/needle3` release at revision
`c1fc4d4cb32993156a880ceb8ff171b03b1f166a`.

- Upstream source: `cactus-compute/needle`
- Model release: `Cactus-Compute/needle3`
- License: Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The build verifies pinned SHA-256 digests before embedding these artifacts.
